objective: Obtain 2 genuinely qualifying repositories; then assess a credible path to the existing larger multi-organization study.
constraints: No outreach without explicit approval. No scraping, experiments, model/manuscript/design changes. Existing screening criteria apply.
follow_up_policy: Dates remain null until an actual message is confirmed sent. Proposed follow-up 7–10 days after actual contact, at most one, subject to authorization. No reminders or automated messages scheduled.

history.detail: Five public-evidence leads assessed and drafts prepared. No messages sent; no owner confirmations or repository screening performed.

candidates.candidate: Astral release-infrastructure owner / Ruff release maintainers
candidates.reason_for_contact: Maintainer release instructions describe GitHub Actions builds followed by another team member's deployment approval before PyPI publication.
candidates.qualification_likelihood: Plausible; strongest first operator inquiry. Exact gate/job scope, 20 approved started executions/month, natural adverse cases and passive access remain unverified.
candidates.contact_method: Ruff GitHub Discussions, General: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/discussions ; ask for the release-infrastructure owner. No verified direct owner email.
candidates.next_action: User reviews ACQ-001 draft and chooses whether to authorize this one message.
candidates.final_outcome: OPEN — no qualification or participation decision

candidates.next_action: Hold draft; after first candidate, ask only current protected execution volume and willingness to discuss.
